assumptions: Party of 5 (2 adults; kids 8/13/16). Depart Croatia (DBV primary, SPU fallback) Sun Oct 25 or Mon Oct 26 2026 — first days of IATA winter timetable W26. Home to SFO Mon Oct 26 – Wed Oct 28. Fares are estimates unless marked live-verified; no live GDS quotes were pulled.

verified: Winter W26/27 begins Oct 25 2026; most seasonal DBV/SPU routes end Oct 24-25.

Ryanair W26/27: DBV-Dublin and DBV-Krakow become YEAR-ROUND; DBV keeps winter links to Ireland, UK, Poland; DBV-Vienna and DBV-Charleroi winter routes DROPPED (croatianaviation.com / tportal.hr / bengeri.com, Jul 2026).

Croatia Airlines winter from DBV: DBV-ZAG domestic year-round; DBV-Frankfurt ~3x/wk (Tue/Fri/Sun pattern last winter); NEW: Zagreb-Madrid extended into winter from Oct 26 2026 (3x/wk) with advertised connections from Dubrovnik/Split (croatianaviation.com).
Air Serbia DBV-Belgrade goes year-round from Oct 26 2026, 3x/wk (croatianaviation.com).

Historic winter internationals at DBV: Turkish (Istanbul), Vueling (Barcelona), BA (Gatwick) — pattern per Total Croatia News; W26/27 continuation likely but NOT yet confirmed in a published W26/27 PDF (dbv.hr still shows summer schedule).
Austrian VIE-DBV described as seasonal July-November — likely still flying Oct 25/26 (airportinformation.com); verify exact end date.

ranking.why: Bulletproof: 3 year-round SFO nonstop carriers, likely BA/Ryanair winter link from DBV, Virgin lie-flat on Amex points, and Harry Potter Halloween + half-term theatre energy for all three kids.
Disneyland Paris Halloween Festival is the single best Halloween-week kid draw in Europe, AF daily nonstop + Flying Blue is the strongest points path — only knock is the forced one-stop from DBV.

The timetable-change cheat code: Ryanair DBV-DUB just went YEAR-ROUND, Halloween was invented in Ireland (Bram Stoker Festival that exact weekend), Aer Lingus nonstop with US preclearance and cheap Avios lie-flats — lowest total cost of the top tier.
One airline door-to-door (TK DBV-IST + daily IST-SFO 777), most memorable stopover and cheapest hotels — loses points on the 13h flight home and near-zero Amex points usability.

Warmest and most beach/Camp Nou fun, likely Vueling winter nonstop from DBV — but Level's SFO cancellation leaves only United's end-of-season flight, a genuine schedule-boundary gamble that must be verified before booking.

caveats: All cash fares and hotel figures are late-Oct estimates, NOT live quotes — the only live-verified facts are route existence/seasonality items cited per candidate.

Dubrovnik Airport has not yet published its official W26/27 timetable PDF; Turkish (IST), Vueling (BCN), and BA (LGW) winter continuations at DBV are historic-pattern inferences and must be confirmed when the winter schedule posts (~Sep 2026).
United SFO-BCN and Iberia MAD-SFO operate at seasonal/low-frequency boundaries in the exact Oct 26-28 window — verify exact operating dates before choosing Barcelona or Madrid.
Oct 25 2026 is winter-timetable day 1: any itinerary relying on a 'summer' DBV nonstop (CDG, MUC, ZRH, AMS, CPH direct) should be treated as dead unless a specific extension is confirmed.

Lie-flat award space for a party of 5 (or 4 + 1) is the real constraint everywhere; Flying Blue (Paris/Amsterdam/Copenhagen) and Avios-on-Aer-Lingus (Dublin) are the two most realistic multi-seat plays from Amex MR.
